description: NaV₂O₄ is Spinel structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-66°. There are two shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.19 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and four longer (2.03 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and three V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaV₃ tetrahedra.
